name: Fatal Attraction
description: Each pulse-pounding hour-long episode centers around an incredible and dangerous romance. Shocking crime, kidnapping or even murder is only half of the story! In the end, the “true love” that draws these couples together isn’t the kind that celebrates silver anniversaries – instead it leads to cross-country manhunts, bizarre cover-ups and dramatic trials. Driven by powerful, real-life stories, Fatal Attraction weaves together intimate, first-person interviews, exclusive interrogation footage and rare archival material. Along the way, it gives you a glimpse into the dark heart of a dangerous romance. Listen as the key players, family of the survivors and those that investigated the horrific crimes reveal the secrets to each sordid tale. Fatal Attraction… because love doesn’t just hurt, it can kill!

videos.title: With This Bullet, I Thee Kill
videos.overview: Avis Banks and Keyon Pittman appeared to have it all until Keyon returned home to find his fiancee lifeless on the floor. In their hunt for Avis's killer, investigators unearth a twisted love triangle, and a secret lover with a deadly obsession.

videos.title: Broken Vows, Bloody Murder
videos.overview: Pastor Tracy Burleson and his wife Paulette's world crumbles when Paulette is brutally murdered outside their Houston home; as police look deeper, they uncover a sinful conspiracy of biblical proportions.

videos.title: Prisoner of Love
videos.overview: Brooklyn native Denetria Council fell head over heels for the handsome and charismatic Jason Page. But within months, a cloud of jealousy and obsession cast a dark shadow over their storybook romance. Then the dark feelings turn violent, and escalate into a gruesome nightmare with no escape in sight.

videos.title: A Devil in Uniform
videos.overview: Samira Watkins had fallen hard for naval officer, Zachary Littleton. But when Samira inexplicably goes missing, the search to find her would unveil a tightly wound web of secrets and lies. And when this web begins to unravel, it exposes a hidden evil that will tear a family apart.

videos.title: Shopping for Murder
videos.overview: Derrick and Linda Yancey have been together since high school. The young lovers got married soon after graduation and stayed devoted to each other for more than 20 years. But Derrick would become so infatuated with money that it eventually would cost him and Linda everything.

videos.title: Blazing Fury
videos.overview: Nikki McPhatter had just begun a torrid romance with a man she met online. But Nikki's love life took a horrifying turn when she suddenly went missing. The search for the truth would uncover a conspiracy of deception and revenge. And expose a deadly monster hidden in plain sight.

videos.title: Till Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: Tamika and Quincy Norton seemed like the perfect couple. But their dream life was shattered when one of them fell victim to a horrendous crime. To uncover the truth, investigators would unravel a twisted tale of deceit and revenge. And determine how a collision of desires became a road map to murder.

videos.title: A Cry in the Dark
videos.overview: Tameka Claiborne and Michael Solomon seemed like the perfect couple. But in 2010, Tameka and Michael both went missing. In their hunt to recover the missing couple, police would uncover a sordid trail of lies, abuse, and deception. A trail that ultimately leads to murder.

videos.title: Ambushed by Love
videos.overview: Craig and Cynthia Anderson were madly in love, but it wasn't long before their fairytale romance was put to the test. When a man intrudes on the Andersons West Palm Beach property, they gun him down and claim self-defense. However, when he survives the incident, investigators learn there may be more to this story than meets the eye.

videos.title: The Devil Beside Me
videos.overview: Winston and Darlene George seemed to have the perfect marriage, but a tragic act of violence would rip them apart forever. When investigators begin to search for answers, they discover a tangled web of sex, lies, and greed.

videos.title: Collegiate Killing
videos.overview: A bright future and a loving fiancée, grad student Denita Smith seemed to have it all…until she was found at the bottom of her stairs, a bullet hole in the back of her head. Who would want to kill Denita?

videos.title: The Sinner and the Saint
videos.overview: Kristopher Miller and Kim Griffin had just begun their steamy new romance when a tragic crime would stop it dead in its tracks. Investigators initially expect the crime to be linked to gang violence, which is prevalent in the area; however, after digging deeper they discover a chilling tale of jealousy and vengeance.

videos.title: Murder in Niagara
videos.overview: On the surface, Robert and Ahkenya Johnson had a picture perfect marriage. But according to friends and family, Robert’s behavior had become increasingly erratic. When the mother of two is found by her husband was he the last person to see her alive? He’s got an alibi, but will it convince authorities and Ahkenya’s family?

videos.title: Tragic Rebound
videos.overview: Tamika Huston had big dreams of becoming a singer and a promising future ahead of her, but when she inexplicably goes missing, friends and family worry they’ll never get to see her reach her full potential. The search for answers will lead law enforcement down a slew of different paths—will they ever be able to track down this beautiful young songstress?

videos.title: Hell Hath No Fury
videos.overview: Brian and Elicia Hughes seemed to have a picture perfect marriage; high school sweethearts with two daughters and a nice home in an affluent neighborhood. But when a 911 call leads to a disturbing crime, their perfect life turns up to be not so perfect.

videos.title: Sins and Secrets
videos.overview: Pastor Anthony Hopkins and his wife, Arletha, were living their dreams with their seven beautiful children. Years later, someone comes forward with a shocking revelation that will prove there was more to Arletha’s death than anyone could ever imagine.

videos.title: Budding Bloodshed
videos.overview: Tiffany and Antwan fell head over heels in love for each other, but once Tiffany had Antwan’s child, she found starting a family in high school was far from easy. And when an argument between the two lovers leaves Antwan dead, everyone’s wondering what could push this girl to kill her first love.

videos.title: Raging Revenge
videos.overview: Tawanna Barnes-Copeland seemed to have it all – three beautiful daughters and a budding romance. Until one fateful day when her daughter came home to find the unthinkable. The investigation would leave detectives wondering – was Tawanna the victim of a deadly robbery? Or was there someone out there who wanted her dead?

videos.title: Horror on the Highway
videos.overview: The story of Ryan and Serika Holness begins in Jamaica, but ends tragically in a Maryland field. Ryan’s reports of a carjacker sends police on a manhunt but when detectives add up the evidence, they start to believe the killer may be closer than they think.

videos.title: If I Can't Have You
videos.overview: When dashing young Michael Brooks falls for a sexy older woman named Dorothy Washington, their desire for each other can’t be contained. But when Michael is brutally gunned down inside Dorothy’s apartment, their steamy romance would be forever put on hold. As law enforcement attempt to piece together what happened, they uncover a twisted tale of lies, jealousy, and violence.

videos.title: Fallen Hero
videos.overview: When Officer Wayne Irby stops by Denise Miller’s home on a courtesy call, she falls hard for the man in uniform. But when both Wayne and Denise turn up missing, his fellow officers find out just how mad love can be!

videos.title: Texas Tragedy
videos.overview: When beautiful young coed Tynesha Stewart goes missing just miles from her boyfriend’s apartment, her family and friends grow more anxious by the hour. But a shocking confession from a familiar face not only divulges Tynesha’s fate, but also the presence of a true monster, and a sickening crime.

videos.title: A Lethal Love Affair
videos.overview: Young newlyweds Latrese and Darin Curtis were reveling in the joy of their fledgling marriage—but no sooner had they begun their new life together than Latrese would be murdered in a horrific act of violence - found stabbed to death on the side of a busy highway. The search for answers will uncover a tangled web of sex, lies, and salacious secrets that will shock even the most seasoned investigators.

videos.title: Burning Rage
videos.overview: Latonya Bowman and Jamal Rogers were one month shy of welcoming their baby boy into the world when the unthinkable happened. Latonya is kidnapped, set on fire, shot, and left for dead. As Latonya fights to save her life and the life of her unborn son, detectives try to figure out who would want to harm her – and in such a violent way. As this mystery begins to unravel they uncover a selfish murder plot that sends shockwaves throughout the Detroit community – and the entire country.

videos.title: All in the Family
videos.overview: When mother of three Kenyatae Collier-Brewer goes missing, her husband Darron immediately notifies police. The search is on for this beloved nurse before time runs out. But after investigators uncover her abandoned vehicle, they are quickly thrust into a twisted tale of deception and betrayal.

videos.title: Harvard Homicide
videos.overview: Brittany Smith and Jabrai Copney were a young collegiate power-couple who had the world at their fingertips. But their textbook romance is cut short when a young man is murdered in broad daylight on Harvard’s campus – where Brittany is a proud student. When Brittany inexplicably goes missing soon after this tragedy occurs, investigators wonder if there might have been two victims. When they dig deeper, they’ll uncover a tangled web of lies that will shock the entire Cambridge community.

videos.title: Deadly Rampage
videos.overview: A modern day Bonnie and Clyde, Shanda Merritt and Carl Davis had penchant for criminal behavior. But when Carl decides to leave Shanda and go on the straight and narrow, it sparks a chain reaction of heinous acts leaving one man dead and another in critical condition.

videos.title: Love Triangle Tragedy
videos.overview: When 22-year-old airport baggage handler Erika Yancey goes missing, friends and family scramble with law enforcement to find her. Erika had a habit of meeting strangers online, which leads her family to fear that she may have gotten caught up with the wrong person. But once the search gets going, a steamy affair and a tangled love triangle will be revealed that will send the case spiraling in a whole new direction.

videos.title: Pure Evil
videos.overview: Eddy Curry and Nova Henry have a relationship that turns rocky once Eddy is drafted to the NBA and she has two of his children. But when Nova and her 10-month old daughter Ava turn up dead in the wake of a child support case, police are baffled as to what monster could commit such a heinous crime.

videos.title: Millionaire Murder
videos.overview: Lance Herndon was renown throughout Atlanta for being one of the city’s most successful businessmen and dashing playboys. Celebrated for his rigorous work ethic and lavish parties, Lance was viewed as Atlanta’s own “Great Gatsby.” But when his mother finds him bludgeoned to death one morning in his bedroom, no one can fathom what Lance could have done to deserve such a graphic beating. After a slew of greedy mistresses are unveiled, they become investigators’ prime suspects—but could any of these petite women really be capable of such a violent crime?

videos.title: Toxic Romance
videos.overview: Reginald Daye falls helplessly in love with Crystal Magnum. He sees their union as kismet, but is stabbed to death in his home not long after.The subsequent investigation unearths a scandalous and long-buried secret in the community of Durham.

videos.title: California Cold Case
videos.overview: Marie Singleton disappears in late 1994, after falling for Andre Jackson and conceiving his child. The ensuing investigation stretches out over decades until a discovery solves the case and suggests that Marie may have been at risk from the beginning.

videos.title: Lethal Liaison
videos.overview: Cicely Bolden is stabbed to death in the wake of a sexual romance with Larry Dunn. Investigators look into the case and discover many buried secrets and a shocking conclusion.

videos.title: Feast of the Flesh
videos.overview: When Manny and Exondia first met, sparks immediately began to fly. It wasn’t long before the couple’s sensual romance blossomed into something more—they were soon having a baby and getting married. But only five years into their blissful union, Manny would go inexplicably missing, ripping the life of this happy couple apart at the seams. The investigation into Manny’s disappearance reveals a sordid secret...

videos.title: Law and Murder
videos.overview: Phyllis Malone never expected to find love as a result of a domestic violence call, but that’s exactly what happened. The dashing knight-in-shining-armor has an instant connection with the beautiful damsel-in-distress and a sexy romance ignites. It appears nothing can tear the couple apart, but their flame is swiftly put out when Phyllis is discovered murdered inside her vehicle. Is it possible her past of domestic violence has come back to haunt her? Or could Phyllis’ search for love have awoken something much worse…

videos.title: A Sinister Affair
videos.overview: Yamisha Thomas and Sylvester Davis had chemistry that couldn’t be tamed; sparks flew in the bedroom, and Sylvester was a great father figure for Yamisha’s young daughter. Just when it seemed their relationship couldn’t get more perfect, Yamisha goes missing inexplicably after she fails to pick up her daughter from a family member’s home. The investigation into her disappearance will reveal some alarming secrets, and beg the question… did her past come back to haunt her?

videos.title: Deadly Secret
videos.overview: “Cece” Dove was a vivacious young woman looking for love. But when she mysteriously disappears, investigators can’t help but wonder if her online dating profile could have landed her in the hands of an internet predator. On the other side of town the body of a male is discovered, the victim of a heinous murder. Investigators make an incredible discovery causing the cases to collide in the most shocking of ways.

videos.title: Dance of Death
videos.overview: Debbie Flores-Narvaez was a beautiful showgirl looking to fall in love. When she vanishes without a trace, investigators can’t help but wonder if she had gotten caught up in the lifestyle of the night and ended up as just another of the lost souls missing from the City of Sin. But when Debbie’s car turns up across town, investigators uncover a love triangle involving the reigning queen of the Vegas showgirls and a dark secret so lurid it could be worth killing for.

videos.title: Deadly Jealousy
videos.overview: Jennifer Lewis never expected that she’d have a relationship as meaningful as the one she had with God, but that changed when she met the charming and devout Melvin Reed. Soon, a fast and deep romance blossomed, held together by their mutual love of God. Jennifer and Melvin’s romance is snuffed out prematurely when she is shot on campus at close-range. Is it possible a secret from her past has come back to haunt her or had her search for love put her in contact with something much more sinister?

videos.title: The Boy is Mine
videos.overview: Curtisha Morning was an ambitious young student focused on her career and not her love life, but that all changed when she met Carl Brown. He opened up a new exciting world that Curtisha had never experienced. When Curtisha vanishes into thin air, investigators are at a loss as to what could have happened to the ambitious young teen. Soon, a dark secret is exposed, one so reprehensible it just might prove motive for murder.

videos.title: Mortal Matrimony
videos.overview: For Juatasha Denton, failure was not in her vocabulary. She always got what she wanted in life and love, and what she wanted most was Ray McCaster. Soon, innocent flirtations turned into full-blown romance and they ended up tying the knot. Their happy world of married bliss is shattered when a dismembered body is found just miles from the couple’s house. Investigators uncover a secret so dark it may just have brought the young lovers onto a collision course with evil.

videos.title: AWOL Abduction
videos.overview: When Kimberly Parker said “I do” to, Elihue Parker, he promised her the world, but their dreams for a bright future are dashed when Elihue turns up missing. As investigators delve deeper, they uncover a twisted ring of greed and deception that will leave them face to face with pure evil.

videos.title: Heart of Darkness
videos.overview: When Wynetta Wright met hard-nosed cop Richmond Phillips, sparks flew right away and soon they were embroiled in a heated romance. Nine months later, Wynetta gave birth to their daughter, Jaylin. Then, nearly a year later, their hopes of happiness are dashed as both Wynetta and baby Jaylin unexpectedly disappear. As investigators delve deeper into Wynetta and Jaylin’s disappearance, they find themselves suddenly caught in a sordid web of love and lust, bringing them face to face with an evil that can’t be named.

videos.title: Last Act
videos.overview: When local actress Pasinetta Prince met charmer, Patrick Bauldwin, he fanned her flame and together they formed the perfect partnership. The curtain dropped on their love affair when Pasinetta was found strangled in her own home. As investigators wade through the cast of suspects, they soon uncover a sordid secret that will rattle the community to its core.

videos.title: Dangerous Addiction
videos.overview: When navy veteran Eric Clark met gorgeous Constance Harris, a friendship developed that soon shot into the stratosphere of love; marriage quickly followed. Their dreams of happiness were cut short when Eric didn't make it back home from a trip to Atlanta and is later found shot to death. As investigators delve into the case, they are soon led on a frenzied manhunt for a diabolical killer and, in the process, reveal a murky world where greed and betrayal take the front seat.

videos.title: A Flaming Hot Fling
videos.overview: After falling in love at first sight with Melody Williams, the remains of ex-running back L.C. Lyons are found in a bizarre house fire. Cops reach out to the lady that he fell hard for, Melody, to see if she has any idea what happened. Jewelry and thousands in cash is missing.

videos.title: Big Rig Rage
videos.overview: After years of financial worry, Valencia, a 40-year-old mom of 4, was on the up. A romance blossoming with a fellow truck driver was stopped dead in its tracks when she is found shot to death in the sleeping compartment of her rig.

videos.title: Bayou Bloodshed
videos.overview: Chiquita, a 34-year-old attorney, is found stabbed to death in her office. She was a happy woman in love, but was her life as simple as it seemed? Detectives unravel a twisted tale of love triangles.

videos.title: Innocence Slaughtered
videos.overview: After falling for basketball star Matthew Wilkins, popular teen Marlisa is found stabbed to death. Who would want to murder this love-struck teen? Is it her jealous boyfriend, an ex, or someone else?

videos.title: A Lethal Love
videos.overview: A father and his two children are found murdered; investigators soon find themselves targeting an unexpected suspect.

videos.title: Grim Obsession
videos.overview: A successful businessman falls into a relationship with a wild, young woman that ends with his shooting death.

videos.title: Jarring Jealousy
videos.overview: 21-year-old Shadae Taylor-Brooks' body was found deceased in her apartment in Lancaster, PA. A terrifying picture of jealousy and abuse will emerge and the circumstances surrounding her death will prove to be a challenge for authorities.

videos.title: A Scorching Suspicion
videos.overview: University of Florida popular college cheerleader, Saleha Huuda's charred body is found along a roadside brushfire in Gainesville, FL. Detectives learn that Saleha's 21-year-old boyfriend, Antonio Drayton, was seeing other women. With their relationship based on a history of abuse, lies and betrayal, anyone could be the killer.

videos.title: Metered Murder
videos.overview: A husband and cabbie is found murdered in his cab, and investigators discover family secrets and lies.

videos.title: A Deadly Message
videos.overview: A hand and foot are left at Sandra's door and a note pinned to her car. In another part of town, a dog leads his owner to another hand and foot in a bag. Police investigate as bags of dismembered body parts found around town.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: Latrice doesn't pick her daughter up from school, as she always had. Her life is going well, except for a current child custody battle, or so it seems. Is her current love, her ex-partner, or someone else behind this mystery?

videos.title: Death Toll
videos.overview: A gunman walks through traffic and kills Deborah, a 51-year-old toll booth worker at her booth. A truck has a 2nd victim, 58-year-old security guard Ersie. Is a spree shooter on the loose, or were they targeted for a reason?

videos.title: Old Habits Die Hard
videos.overview: Clarence Goode is found shot dead in his car on the sketchy side of town, leading to a sticky web of superstition.

videos.title: Crippled by Blood
videos.overview: A heart-breaking unthinkable tragedy occurs when a brother and sister are shot to death in their home, but they are not the only victims. The ensuing police investigation uncovers shocking secrets.

videos.title: Entrepre-murder
videos.overview: Lesley moves to L.A., meets a handsome guy in a store and marries him the following year. They spend many happy years together before they disappear without a trace. Investigators chase many leads, and have a complicated and unusual case on their hands.

videos.title: The Iris of Evil
videos.overview: A single mother meets a handsome stranger who promised her everything, but their romance ends when she is discovered shot to death in her bedroom. As investigators search for the truth, they will find themselves in a maze of misleading witnesses - where liars, lovers, and cheats lay at every wicked turn.

videos.title: Blazed Outrage
videos.overview: A young, single mom, working hard to pay her bills, meets a new man. Their happy life together ends in a horrific act - their house is set on fire, he is badly burnt and she is found deceased.

videos.title: Sin for the Son
videos.overview: Lucia, a strong-willed Caribbean mother, fights for a better life for her sick son. Soon after moving from St. Lucia to Toronto, she meets Patrick. Her sister can't reach her and cops enter the apartment to find a bloodbath.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: In the season premiere, a football player becomes a prime suspect when his girlfriend, Tavia, goes missing and detectives expose a trail of lies, cheating and murder amongst other players.

videos.title: Excess Baggage
videos.overview: Christie's disappearance is investigated, and her son was one of the last people to see her. The search for her partner begins, but soon the investigation changes course unearthing a tale of violence, deception and disguise.

videos.title: Hidden Homicide
videos.overview: A Iraqi war veteran in a relationship goes missing, only for her body to reappear on her front lawn; the investigation reveals things aren't as they seem.

videos.title: Two-Timing Terror
videos.overview: A 6-months pregnant Latoyia mysteriously disappears after meeting with an old flame. Cops discover she is in a love triangle but it takes a while for them to find her, and the killer is caught in the act of moving her body.

videos.title: Social Media Murder
videos.overview: A high school football player falls victim to a fatal stabbing and an investigation leads to control, secrets, sex and an unlikely killer.

videos.title: Blood in the Bayou
videos.overview: Bethany is a victim of kidnapping in broad daylight and the investigation uncovers a twisted tale of unbelievable treachery.

videos.title: Badge of Betrayal
videos.overview: A police officer disappears without a trace into a world of sexual infidelity and violence, after having an affair with a female inmate.

videos.title: Sex, Drugs and Murder
videos.overview: A couple is targeted by a hail of gunfire, and investigators find out they were attacked because of their sexual habits.

videos.title: High-Rise Hit
videos.overview: When a car salesman is discovered shot to death in his bed, the investigation leads to a trail of passion, deceit, and bitter jealousy.

videos.title: A Plot to Kill
videos.overview: A charming man with a deadly sense of humour is viciously murdered by an unexpected culprit.

videos.title: She Never Came Home
videos.overview: A college student goes missing after beginning a relationship with with a new boyfriend; investigators reveal the possibility of a love triangle.

videos.title: Blood and Black Magic
videos.overview: After a woman is found dead in her bedroom, investigators find themselves pursuing leads that take them on a dark path of lust and betrayal.

videos.title: Family Massacre
videos.overview: The murder of a woman, her three children and her mother leads detectives on an investigation full of shocking surprises.

videos.title: Hidden Agenda
videos.overview: A tale of deception and jealousy unravels between a group of unsuspecting friends; a woman is assaulted in a series of strange, brutal attacks. Investigators uncover a story of deception, jealousy and rage.

videos.title: Deadly Ultimatum
videos.overview: A twisted love triangle between a class president and a cheerleader turns deadly in a picturesque South Carolina town.

videos.title: Lavish Lies
videos.overview: A woman is murdered and her husband is badly injured after a gunman brutally  attacks them, but an investigation by dedicated detectives reveals two surprising co-conspirators.

videos.title: Deadly Double Life
videos.overview: After a social worker is found with a fatal gunshot wound to the back of her head in her truck, authorities unearth a dark secret.

videos.title: Deadly Trio
videos.overview: Sheryl, a young executive, is shot and killed, revealing a secret love affair that stuns her friends and family.

videos.title: Killer Cult
videos.overview: A woman is reported missing, soon after a four-year-old boy disappears in the same area leading investigators down a treacherous path into a house of horrors where despicable acts are committed in the name of love.

videos.title: Demons of the Past
videos.overview: Recovering addict Roderick is gunned down outside his home after getting his life seemingly back on track.

videos.title: Road Trip Terror
videos.overview: Cheryl Miranda, a 56-year-old woman, is found dead by police after her truck catches fire in the woods. When police start investigating, they uncover the tragic tale of romance that turned deadly.

videos.title: Ruthless Rivalry
videos.overview: Kadijah falls victim to gang warfare when she is shot to death in a parked car in a dangerous neighborhood; a story of star-crossed lovers is revealed.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: A flight attendant seemingly vanishes into thin air; authorities discover her body in the middle of a forest preserve.

videos.title: When the Smoke Clears
videos.overview: Keiona Braxton's body is found in the aftermath of what is seemingly an accidental fire; it's soon revealed to be caused by a deadly obsession.

videos.title: Slaying in the Street
videos.overview: Travis Green is fatally shot by an unknown assailant and his girlfriend disappears, leading investigators on a path of lies and deceit.

videos.title: Wrecked by Love
videos.overview: An aspiring rapper is killed in a car accident, but the funeral director makes a shocking discovery that turns the entire investigation on its head which causes the police to investigate the accident as a murder.

videos.title: Watcher in the Night
videos.overview: A late night party ends in a fatal mass shooting, revealing a crime of passion that no one could have stopped.

videos.title: Lethal Weapon
videos.overview: When Shari, a hospital worker, is fatally shot at home, investigators turn their attention to her husband who maintains she killed herself by accident with his gun.

videos.title: Into the Woods
videos.overview: Tyronne's girlfriend goes missing and a threat is uncovered that was made before she disappeared forcing the police to ask questions.

videos.title: In the Line of Fire
videos.overview: Police suspect foul play when a woman is hit by a stray bullet, and a devastating car crash results from the incident.

videos.title: Deception in D.C.
videos.overview: When Antoinette is found dead of an apparent suicide, evidence of foul play is soon uncovered that has detectives questioning the real cause of death.

videos.title: A Heart Divided
videos.overview: While in the garage of her dream home, Lanell is killed by an unknown assailant with a deadly gunshot she never saw coming.

videos.title: Smoke and Mirrors
videos.overview: The city of Chicago is in a state of shock when one of their rising stars disappears without warning and with no clues to her whereabouts.

videos.title: Thicker Than Water
videos.overview: Shikhira Dunson seems to have it all, until a shooting in Decatur, GA, takes away all her hopes and dreams.

videos.title: Death Trap
videos.overview: On a deserted back country road, hardworking father Leon Baucham is found dead with a gunshot wound to his back.

videos.title: Gone Too Soon
videos.overview: A week after she disappeared, the body of a young woman appears in the trunk of her car. Police investigate the woman's dating life as they search for her murderer.

videos.title: Death by Secrets
videos.overview: Detectives examine the shooting death of a beautiful young woman found dead inside her car. During the investigation, the authorities uncover the nursing student's shocking backstory.

videos.title: Without a Trace
videos.overview: A story of passion, jealousy and murder comes to light in a tight-knit suburban community following the mysterious disappearance of a popular salon owner.

videos.title: Murder in a College Town
videos.overview: A pre-med student vanishes without a trace while evidence that reveals her disappearance and murder slips by the detectives.

videos.title: Murder, M.D.
videos.overview: Police hunt for a murderer with a motive after a doctor is discovered shot to death in a carpark. A clue leads them to believe the killing was a crime of passion.

videos.title: What Nobody Knew
videos.overview: A daughter's dream for a happy future is shattered with gunfire at her mother's apartment; love lies bleeding and a life is hanging by a thread.

videos.title: Gasping for Air
videos.overview: The death of a woman leaves two young daughters without a mother. Police are wondering if either of her two ex-boyfriends are to blame, or another person entirely.

videos.title: Deadly Divorce
videos.overview: When a husband's younger brother is mysteriously found dead on his family's front porch, a marriage's chance at restoration is destroyed.

videos.title: Master of Deceit
videos.overview: A jealous man tracks the movements of his ex-girlfriend and her new relationship. His envy eventually tips him over the edge as he risks all in his dangerous attempts at getting revenge.

videos.title: Early Morning Murder
videos.overview: Bus driver Rita Salton is killed as she makes her routine journey to work. Her murder remains unsolved for nearly a year before clues begin to reveal themselves.

videos.title: A Text from the Grave
videos.overview: In the sixth season premiere, a woman vanishes without a trace after moving from her home in Trinidad to be with her longtime boyfriend.

videos.title: Risky Rendezvous
videos.overview: Detectives contend with a growing list of suspects after a man with multiple girlfriends is found dead in his apartment parking lot.

videos.title: Blazing Love Triangle
videos.overview: A beautiful, faith-filled young woman vanishes without a trace, unfurling a thread of secrecy and a tale of vicious jealousy.

videos.title: Dangerous Appeal
videos.overview: When a devoted father and husband is fatally shot, police discover he has been leading a double life filled with drugs, lies, and former lovers.

videos.title: A Deadly Snowfall
videos.overview: A high school senior's violent murder reveals a secretive world of teen romance and mental illness amid a wild winter storm.

videos.title: Puppet Master
videos.overview: An Air Force veteran is stalked by a diabolical figure from his past that is determined to take him for everything he is worth.

videos.title: Hair Stylist Homicide

videos.overview: When 44-year-old single mom Susan Christian is found dead in the woods, bound with her skull fractured in 2005, Rome, GA police suspect she may be the victim of a sexual predator, especially when they learn she moonlighted as an escort.

videos.title: Death in the Cul-de-sac
videos.overview: When a beloved father and businessman is gunned down outside of his home, police believe he is the victim of a targeted attack. As they uncover details regarding his more covert side, a motive for revenge is soon unveiled.

videos.title: Unearthed Secrets
videos.overview: When a young woman suddenly vanishes without a trace, the Cleveland Police immediately embark upon an investigation determined to find answers. As the mystery deepens, a horrifying discovery unearths a story of deadly betrayal, jealousy, and infidelity.

videos.title: The Devil Inside Me
videos.overview: When independent 18-year-old Brittany Clardy mysteriously disappears in the dead of winter in Minneapolis, MN, police are determined to crack the case. As investigators begin to piece together her secret double life, a cold-blooded killer with a shocking motive is unveiled.

videos.title: Sinful Betrayal
videos.overview: When 46-year-old Kendra Jackson, a mother of three, is found dead from a gunshot wound by her fiancé William Pounds in Macon, GA, in 2015, investigators are led to believe it was a suicide. But, as additional details and witness accounts come forward, the investigation reveals a secret double life that led to murder.

videos.title: Lover's Quarrel
videos.overview: After 28-year-old single mom Vanessa Williams' body is found with stab wounds in a Delray, FL ditch, police are thrown into a case full of betrayal and deceit. The detectives rifle through her past relationships to uncover a violent killer with devilish motivations.

videos.title: Into Thin Air
videos.overview: When 18-month-old Isaiah is found wandering the streets of Detroit alone, a search ensues to find his missing mother, Nicole Smith. The investigation reveals a connection to a serial sexual predator, leading to a chilling discovery and a haunting saga of fraud.

videos.title: Evil Escapes
videos.overview: When 20-year-old single mom of two Sharonda Clark goes missing in Tulsa, OK, police visit her home and discover the young mother, stabbed multiple times. As investigators dig into her life, her past with a mysterious lover may be the clue they need to find her killer.

videos.title: One for the Money
videos.overview: When detectives discover Elmore Allen Jr.'s body on the grounds of an Austin, TX apartment complex, they are thrust into a case with multiple suspects, conflicting stories, and startling revelations. From a night of revelry to betrayal, a web of deceit is exposed.

videos.title: No Remorse
videos.overview: After a home intruder stabs 29-year-old Brian Spinks, a father and Air Force Sergeant in Shreveport, LA, police are determined to catch the killer. As detectives dig deeper, they uncover a suspect at the center of their investigation.

videos.title: Depraved Mind
videos.overview: When Danielle Stubbs is found dead by her family inside her home in Jacksonville, FL, investigators dive in to identify a suspect. But, as they race to uncover the timeline of events leading up to her death, they discover a love triangle, fueled with jealousy and rage.

videos.title: Trail of Violence
videos.overview: When Ashley Mays, a pregnant single mother, is found murdered in a Georgia hotel room, DeKalb County detectives fear her attacker might strike again. A race against the clock, detectives must untangle a disturbing trail of violence involving multiple victims and one sadistic predator.

videos.title: Deathly Betrothal
videos.overview: When wife and mother Stacey Griffin Devine's body is found in a ditch on the outskirts of Jonesboro, AR, in 2016, the small town is sent into a tailspin. Detectives must determine if this was a random act of violence, or the result of her strained marriage that was splitting at the seams. The case goes cold and 3 years later it's picked up by investigators on the show "Cold Justice".

videos.title: Femme Fatale
videos.overview: When 34-year-old Air Force veteran Martell DeRouen aka Cardone, an up-and-coming rapper and cousin of Beyoncé, is fatally shot in his San Antonio, TX home, police are determined to catch the culprit. After discovering a suspicious 911 call placed on the night of the murder, police must track down an unexpected suspect.

videos.title: Dangerous Liaison
videos.overview: When 22-year-old father of twins Dionte Greene, who is openly bisexual, is found shot dead in his car in a neighborhood well-known for illegal activities in 2014, Kansas City, MO police initially surmise his death is a result of a botched drug deal. But as they dig deeper, they learn that his desire for love may have been his downfall.

videos.title: Sinful Secrets
videos.overview: When a young sheriff's deputy, wife and mother, Shakeema Brown Jackson, and her brother, 30-year-old Levoy Brown, are found shot dead in her home in 2021, Covington, GA detectives suspect it was possibly related to a home invasion. But when they look deeper, their investigation leads them to a tumultuous relationship and a man with everything to lose.

videos.title: Silent Betrayal
videos.overview: When the body of 25-year-old pregnant single mom Poinsettia Parks is found near a pond, Concord, CA police are determined to locate her killer. After discovering surveillance footage capturing the victim hours before her death, detectives zero in on an unexpected suspect with a vengeful motive.

videos.title: Out of Control
videos.overview: When 29-year-old single mom Unekeyia 'Nikki' Walker is found dead in her car right outside of her home in 2016, Waco, TX investigators struggle to find proof of any foul play. As they delve deeper into the timeline of events that led up to her death, they uncover a killer who was out of control.

videos.title: Out of the Ordinary
videos.overview: When 16-year-old Diamond Bradley goes missing in January 2018, her family is completely distraught. With no leads, Spring Valley, IL detectives are left grasping at straws. When surveillance footage finally reveals a suspect, they must fight the lies to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Desperate Measures
videos.overview: When a cryptic call reveals that 44-year-old successful businesswoman  and mother Angela Bledsoe has been murdered in her home in 2018, investigators immediately jump into action. With a killer on the run, Montclair, NJ detectives must unravel the secret life hidden behind a powerful family's perfect facade.

videos.title: Shadow of Jealousy
videos.overview: When 20-year-old single mom Janell Aaron goes missing in 2010, leaving behind her 5-month-old baby girl, College Park, GA investigators struggle to figure out where she could have gone. But as they interview those closest to her, they soon uncover a shocking trail of jealousy, violence, and deceit.

videos.title: Ritualistic Obsession
videos.overview: When severe floods lead to the discovery of a mutilated woman, investigators believe it's the work of a serial killer. As old relationships rise to the surface, they'll need to discern the lies from the truth to find the true killer.

videos.title: I Love You to Death
videos.overview: When a rideshare driver is fatally shot behind the wheel of her own vehicle, detectives must track down the masked culprit. Despite uncovering surveillance footage of the entire incident, the case runs cold, until an unexpected witness is identified.

videos.title: Chilling Premonitions
videos.overview: When a single mother is found dead in her apartment, investigators theorize it was the result of a botched sexual assault. With no clear leads, years go by without any answers until a break in the case leaves them with more questions than answers.

videos.title: Brutal Betrayal
videos.overview: When a reformed ex-con is found shot outside an apartment complex, detectives wonder if his criminal past has caught up with him. But after an unexpected witness comes forward, detectives uncover sinister motives closer to home than they expected.

videos.title: Miracles and Monsters
videos.overview: After a couple is brutally attacked, detectives are left hunting for leads. When another woman goes missing, they realize the cases may be connected; their prime suspect continues to evade justice.

videos.title: Bitter Rivalry
videos.overview: A successful, working mother is found dead in her driveway, leaving detectives with more questions than answers.

videos.title: Houston Homicide
videos.overview: When a trip to Houston ends in tragedy, police work tirelessly to find out who murdered a young man in cold blood; after discovering he had met a woman over the weekend, they wonder if the chance meeting could have led to this unthinkable crime.

videos.title: Rhyme of Revenge
videos.overview: When a woman is found shot inside her mother's home, they can't fathom who would want to harm her; but when a suspect is caught fleeing on camera, it takes a vigilant investigation, a surprise connection and a manhunt to bring the killer to justice.

videos.title: A Dangerous Affair
videos.overview: When a missing man is discovered deceased in his bed, with no sign of his family, detectives fear they may still be in danger; working urgently to find them before it's too late, their investigation leads to an unexpected suspect emerging.

videos.title: Disastrous Dreaming
videos.overview: After fulfilling her American dream, a woman suddenly disappears; police suspect foul play and with her family's help, zero in on a suspect; but once her body is found brutally slain, they're afraid her killer has slipped through their fingers.

videos.title: Divine Delusions
videos.overview: Love and stability is all this single mother wanted, but as Christmas comes around, she vanishes; while detectives rush to find answers, they're left chasing an elusive criminal; after the young woman's body is found, another goes missing.

videos.title: Collateral Damage
videos.overview: When a mother is found dead inside her ransacked home, detectives suspect a robbery gone wrong; as investigators piece together her final moments, more motive emerges, exposing a conspiracy and an affair.

videos.title: Harlem Horror
videos.overview: A loving grandmother had it all, with her home in the city and new boyfriend; but things turn sinister when her home becomes the scene of a double murder; soon, detectives uncover a plot that exposes danger closer than anyone expected.

videos.title: The Company You Keep
videos.overview: When an adored single mother vanishes without a trace, friends and family fear the worst. And as detectives piece together the evening of her disappearance, a scorned lover fueled by bitter resentment emerges at the heart of the investigation.

videos.title: A Monster in the Making
videos.overview: When a woman at the peak of her career is found brutally murdered, investigators struggle to make sense of it all. But as the evidence leads them to her killer, it's apparent he has tasted blood and now he wants more.

videos.title: Deadly Dating Game
videos.overview: When a beloved cancer survivor is found dead on the side of a rural highway, police fear her blossoming dating life played a role in her tragic demise; as detectives retrace her final days, they discover an obsessive killer hiding in plain sight.

videos.title: Devil's Playground
videos.overview: When a young woman goes missing, detectives work with her family to unearth a voicemail from an unknown number; but when it leads detectives to a disturbing scene and an unexpected killer, they must have the evidence to put him away.

videos.title: Toxic Intentions
videos.overview: When a dedicated educator is found unresponsive in his home, family and friends are left puzzled by his unexpected passing; after receiving a tip suggesting his death was no accident, police uncover a sophisticated killer with a chilling motive.

videos.title: Shattered Ambitions
videos.overview: When a 17-year-old girl is found shot in her bedroom, the investigation leaves detective scratching their heads as the suspect list piles up. But when you're by surveillance footage unveils a break in the case, detectives are shocked by what they discover.

videos.title: Impulse to Kill
videos.overview: When a young transgender woman is discovered shot and killed, detectives work around the clock to identify her killer. After police learn their victim was attacked in a hate crime mere weeks before her death, a pool of potential suspects emerges.

videos.title: From Hope to Horror
videos.overview: A woman is found dead in a motel room; police suspect a drug crime; an investigation reveals an unexpected killer with a dark motive, unrelated to drugs.

videos.title: Familial Lies
videos.overview: When a dedicated security guard is found murdered in her apartment, police initially suspect a fatal home invasion; but as detectives interview their victim's friends and family, they discover an unassuming assailant consumed by jealousy and greed.

videos.title: Fame and Felony
videos.overview: Rising young rap star Breneisha Lightfoot (aka 'Ahlotta') is reported missing, and detectives find evidence of a violent attack in her home. Yet when their prime suspect goes on the run, they are left scrambling for answers, until they get a call that breaks the case wide open.

videos.title: Lured by Lies
videos.overview: When a vibrant teenager is gunned down outside his home, friends and family are left reeling from the shocking loss. After police discover he was on the phone in the moments leading up to his attack, the search for the mysterious caller begins.

videos.title: Propensity for Violence
videos.overview: On a journey to reclaim her life, a dedicated mother is murdered in cold blood inside a Minneapolis apartment. As detectives get to work, their prime suspect for this brutal crime goes on the run, and they need a miracle to bring the killer in.

videos.title: A Volatile Situation
videos.overview: When a young boy discovers his pregnant mother fatally shot inside their home, investigators are determined to bring her killer to justice. As they uncover details about her love life, a killer driven by a heartless motive emerges.

videos.title: A Deal with the Devil
videos.overview: After moving to the US, a hard-working mother was building a new life for her family. When she goes missing and her purse is found shortly after, covered in blood, detective suspect there is more than meets the eye in this disappearance.

videos.title: A Senseless Tragedy
videos.overview: A young father's promising future is abruptly ended by a tragic shooting. As detectives run into dead ends searching for suspects, a second shooting at the same apartment complex provides a new direction for the investigation.

videos.title: An Evil Spirit
videos.overview: When a young woman fails to pick up her nephews, her family wastes no time filing a report. After uncovering crucial surveillance footage, detectives close in on a prime suspect they believe holds answers to the missing woman's whereabouts.

videos.title: Troubled Waters
videos.overview: When a young couple goes missing, leaving their infant daughter behind, their families are immediately worried. When a major accusation comes to the surface, police fear the plot may be much deeper than they originally suspected.

videos.title: Between Two Lies
videos.overview: When a dedicated father is found stabbed and dumped in a ditch, family and friends are stunned by the tragedy. As detectives search for the killer of this gruesome crime, their investigation uncovers a twisted love triangle gone wrong.

videos.title: Heartless Homicide
videos.overview: When a young boy wakes to find his mother and her boyfriend have been shot in their apartment, friends and family are determined to catch the culprit. After a key suspect goes on the run, the quest for justice becomes a race against time.

videos.title: Keep Your Friends Close
videos.overview: When a Florida college freshman goes missing, the community bands together to find him. The detectives' investigation leads them down a sinister path, uncovering a twisted love triangle that may have gone tragically wrong.

videos.title: Crossed Twice
videos.overview: When a young man is fatally shot on a cold winter morning, detectives turned to the crime's sole witness for answers. When investigators uncover crime scene evidence contradicting their witness' story, they must trust their instincts.

videos.title: Sinister Secrets
videos.overview: A man frantically calls 911 after finding his wife unresponsive in their home, surrounded by their young children. Detectors wonder whether this is an unfortunate case of suicide or if something more sinister is simmering behind the tragedy.

videos.title: Evil Intentions
videos.overview: When a devoted mother is found shot to death inside her car, investigators immediately suspect a crime of passion. As detectives learn more about their victim's romantic history, a familiar suspect with a violent past comes into focus.

videos.title: Flames of Deception
videos.overview: When an apartment catches fire and a young woman is found dead inside, police assume it to be a tragic accident. A closer inspection of the scene unveils a more disturbing case, one the investigators could never have predicted.

videos.title: Trail of a Killer
videos.overview: When a vibrant mother is discovered fatally shot inside a vehicle, friends and family are devastated by the heartbreaking loss. After police learn the victim's young daughter is nowhere to be found, a desperate search for the killer ensues.

videos.title: Controlled by Love
videos.overview: When a mother of five is found murdered in her home, detectives catch a break in the case when a key witness comes forward. Putting the killer behind bars proves to be much more difficult than anticipated.

videos.title: Monster in Plain Sight
videos.overview: When a young, soon-to-be mother suddenly vanishes, her family fears the worst. With various theories surrounding the woman's disappearance, one tip changes everything, uncovering a secret that could break the case wide open.

videos.title: Burning Secrets
videos.overview: A fire in a vacant lot turns into a gruesome discovery when a woman is found shot and burned. As the investigation unfolds, the list of possible suspects continues to grow, but as detectives close in, the real culprit is someone they never expected.

videos.title: The Cost of Loyalty
videos.overview: After surviving the murder of her mother as a child, a young Bronx woman grows up to become a victim's advocate; when her dismembered body is found in a park, the community is stunned.

videos.title: Deadly Double-Cross
videos.overview: Two friends disappear during a shopping trip and when they're found brutally murdered days later, stunning secrets and shocking theories about an affair begin to emerge; law enforcement must race to find their killer and bring them to justice.

videos.title: Pursuing a Phantom
videos.overview: When a nurse is abducted outside of her workplace, police race to locate her; but hope fades when video is uncovered of a mysterious man cleaning out her car and the woman nowhere to be seen.

videos.title: Unmasking a Monster
videos.overview: When an empty nester and healthcare worker disappears in the middle of the COVID-19 pandemic, her family fears something tragic has happened; detectives uncover a suspect whose deadly past may be repeating itself.

videos.title: Dealing with Evil
videos.overview: A young mother and former drug dealer decides to leave the criminal world behind, only to end up murdered; at first, it appears her past may have caught up with her, but a witness soon reveals a betrayal and a motive that's far more personal.

videos.title: A Threat Inked in Blood
videos.overview: A husband returns home and finds his wife stabbed to death with a message written in blood beside her body - You're next. Was she murdered by a rival gang seeking revenge, or is the cryptic threat really a cover for a killer hiding in plain sight?

videos.title: A Desperate Act
videos.overview: When a hard-working Liberian immigrant is found brutally murdered, her family is left reeling. But investigators soon uncover a secret that may have led to her death. With the trail going cold, will they find the killer before they disappear for good?

videos.title: Trapped in a Twisted Fairytale
videos.overview: A young woman with special needs is found dead by her boyfriend, who tells police she was beaten by a group of women. Detectives investigate if she was a victim of bullying until a bombshell discovery in her autopsy leads them straight to her killer.

videos.title: Burning in Betrayal
videos.overview: When a man is found dead in his burning apartment, his girlfriend admits that he had been selling drugs to make more money. To detectives all signs point to a possible rival drug dealer, but will secrets come to light to reveal a more personal motive?

videos.title: A Deadly Charade
videos.overview: A mother is fatally stabbed, and her boyfriend is gravely wounded by an alleged attacker right outside her home. Is this a random act of violence, or is it possible the killer wanted her dead and went to unfathomable lengths to cover their tracks?

videos.title: Deep-Rooted Evil
videos.overview: When a single mother and nurse is found shot in her car, police look to her bitter ex-wife and current girlfriend with rumored anger issues for answers. Will detectives uncover a love triangle gone wrong, or will a more sinister motive be revealed?

videos.title: Tracing the Truth
videos.overview: Police get a frantic call that a young woman has been shot. The victim dies before she can tell them what happened, and the mystery caller is nowhere to be found. As detectives investigate, an unlikely phone call could be the breakthrough they need.

videos.title: A Calculated Cover-Up
videos.overview: Stacey Jones was a single mom who finally found someone to settle down with. But as the new couple prepares to welcome a baby together, Stacey is gunned down. Was this a devastating hate crime or will detectives discover a shocking motive for murder?

videos.title: A Chase for Justice
videos.overview: When a loving single mother is murdered in her own apartment in Essex, MD, police suspect her ex-boyfriend. The case becomes complicated when detectives uncover a potential new suspect, and it will take a high-speed chase through the city to bring the killer to justice.

videos.title: A Cold-Hearted Killer
videos.overview: When a single mother is found beaten, strangled, and stabbed to death in her Houston apartment, police suspect the killer is someone she knew. Was this a custody battle that turned deadly or will a shocking secret reveal a more disturbing motive?

videos.title: Storm of Jealousy
videos.overview: A man who struggled with addiction and mental health is found decomposing in a hotel room after surviving a hurricane. Detectives wonder if he succumbed to his past, but his autopsy tells a different story in a confession turns the case on its head.
